title: Mālama Kula green waste and fire fuel work
summary: At an April 2026 meeting, the Mālama Kula director said the group, founded after the 2023 Kula fire, has removed nearly 2 million pounds of dead and downed trees. In December 2024 the committee deferred the group's green waste item, and the leader said $250,000 would run the program for a year. Its 25 bins had removed over 950 cubic yards, funded by private donations, and an Office of Recovery staff member said she could relay the FY26 budget request.
